ext_description.message: Translate all readable content of the current page via any OpenAI-compatible LLM API.

popup_first_use.message: First time here? Fill in the API Base URL, key and model in Settings first.

popup_status_already.message: This page is already translated (click again to restore)

popup_status_partial.message: (some content failed, click again to retry)

popup_status_no_response.message: No response received, please try again

popup_status_same_lang.message: The page is in $1, which matches the target language $2, so there is nothing to translate

popup_status_same_lang_generic.message: The page already matches the target language, so there is nothing to translate

popup_status_page_unavailable.message: This page is not available (internal or extension page)

popup_status_processing.message: Working… (requesting the translation API, this may take a while)

options_subtitle.message: Translate a whole page through any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

options_section_api_desc.message: Enter your LLM service address and credentials. The extension calls that endpoint directly from this machine.

options_section_prefs_desc.message: Changing the target language takes effect on the next translation.

options_hint_base_url.message: For API Base URL enter the API root address (for example https://api.openai.com/v1, https://api.deepseek.com/v1, http://localhost:11434/v1); the extension appends /chat/completions automatically. Do not enter a web page address or the full /chat/completions endpoint. Compatible with OpenAI / DeepSeek / Qwen / Ollama and others. The key is stored only on this machine in chrome.storage.local.

options_hint_timeout.message: Request timeout is the longest wait for a single translation request (default 120 seconds). Increase it for self-hosted or slow endpoints; lower it to fail faster if the endpoint is sensitive to request body size.

page_busy.message: The previous translation has been running for $1 seconds and the API still has not responded; keep waiting, or refresh the page to cancel

page_not_configured.message: No API key configured yet. Fill it in under Settings and save.

page_same_lang.message: The page is in $1, which matches the target language $2, so there is nothing to translate

page_no_text.message: No translatable text found (the page may still be loading, or the content is inside an iframe)

error_timeout.message: Request timed out ($1 ms, no response): $2 — the address may be unreachable (network/proxy)

error_non_json.message: Non-JSON response from $1 (HTTP $2): $3 — the Base URL should point to the API root address (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1), not a web page or the full /chat/completions endpoint

error_batch_json.message: The API response is not valid JSON. Raw response fragment: $1

error_batch_not_object.message: The LLM response is not a JSON object
